verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no documented capability to version, review, or roll back automations such as Flows or agents. Agentforce DevOps Center is described only as a way to 'build, test, and deploy' apps and agents. The CLI items show scratch orgs, Apex tests, and agent activation. These are adjacent deployment building blocks, not explicit version history, review workflows, or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
